matching_policy: Exact normalized product name AND brand only; ambiguous or partial matches are rejected.
update_schedule: 03:00 UTC daily (05:00 Africa/Cairo during Egypt winter time); API.SH retailer calls run only on the daily schedule, not on manual dispatch or code pushes.

sources.name: PriceLens Egypt multi-store offers API
sources.refresh_policy: API values refreshed hourly; updater requests offers no older than 24 hours; cache not more than 24 hours.
sources.attribution: Display Prices by PriceLens with a link to https://pricelens.store; preserve returned affiliate link exactly.
sources.activation_note: Enabled in the updater configuration. Requires PRICELENS_API_KEY as a GitHub Actions repository secret and a provider plan with market:read access. Until the key is present the updater skips this source without making API calls. This endpoint is the deals feed, not a complete catalogue feed: it imports only recent in-stock discounted offers, exact-matched by product name and brand. Up to 3 pages (300 deals) per daily run; preserve PriceLens attribution and returned links exactly; cache no longer than 24 hours.

sources.name: API.SH Jumia Egypt product and price API
sources.refresh_policy: Daily rotating exact-name searches; only buyable listings from Jumia Egypt are accepted. Offers expire after 14 days without refresh.
sources.attribution: Display API.SH — Jumia Egypt as source and link directly to the Jumia Egypt product listing.
sources.activation_note: One product search per scheduled daily run, rotating across all 15 priority catalogs. Estimated maximum: about 30 calls per month for this provider; combined Jumia and Noon budget about 60 calls per month. Only exact-matched, buyable/in-stock Egypt EGP offers are imported; failed 402 calls stop without retries.

sources.name: Sama Link Store official partner integration API
sources.activation_note: Sama Link issues the integration key after contact; API is server-to-server. Use only products that match an existing catalog entry by exact normalized name and brand.

sources.name: EGID official EGX market data API
sources.refresh_policy: Automatic browser refresh every 30 seconds in licensed live mode or every 60 seconds in delayed mode, only while the stock section is visible; Cloudflare edge cache is 5 seconds.
sources.attribution: Display EGID as source; preserve the market-data timestamp and the granted delay designation.
sources.activation_note: Obtain API access credentials and written permission for public/commercial display from EGID. Store the issued bearer token as the Cloudflare Worker secret EGID_API_TOKEN. Keep delayed mode until EGID explicitly authorizes live redistribution; set EGID_FEED_MODE=live only after that approval.

sources.name: Open Prices Egypt community observations
sources.import_policy: Recent Egypt-only EGP product observations with exact unique product-name and brand matching; stored separately as communityPriceObservations and never used as the primary retail price or a purchase link.
sources.attribution: Credit Open Prices and link to the individual API record. Review ODbL obligations before enabling or combining this database with other sources.
sources.activation_note: Do not enable until the database licensing/reuse implications are reviewed and live Egypt coverage is confirmed. Community observations are not live retailer offers.

sources.name: API.SH Noon Egypt product and price API
sources.refresh_policy: Daily rotating exact-name searches; only in-stock listings from Noon Egypt are accepted. Offers expire after 14 days without refresh.
sources.attribution: Display API.SH — Noon Egypt as source and link directly to the Noon Egypt product listing.
sources.activation_note: One product search per scheduled daily run, rotating across all 15 priority catalogs. Estimated maximum: about 30 calls per month for this provider; combined Jumia and Noon budget about 60 calls per month. Only exact-matched, buyable/in-stock Egypt EGP offers are imported; failed 402 calls stop without retries.

sources.name: Raneen Egypt public read-only product catalogue API
sources.refresh_policy: Daily bounded search rotation across all 15 priority catalogs; only live in-stock EGP listings with a Raneen product URL are eligible; offers expire after 14 days without refresh.
sources.attribution: Display Raneen as the store and Raneen Public Catalogue API as the source; link to the returned Raneen product page.
sources.activation_note: Public read-only API, no key or payment required. Search results are SKU candidates only; each SKU is fetched from the product-detail endpoint and must have a positive EGP price, in_stock=true, a Raneen HTTPS product URL, and a unique exact product-name/brand or exact model-code match. Per run: 40 searches and at most 200 product-detail calls, within the published 600-search/day and 60-detail/min limits. Search candidates remain interleaved across all 15 priority catalogs.

reference_sources.name: Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation — daily crop prices
reference_sources.reason: The official page presents wholesale Obour Market and representative retail prices for vegetables, fruit and fish. Automated query responses did not expose a verified machine-readable price table, and commercial reuse terms were not confirmed. Do not ingest until the Ministry confirms an approved export/API and reuse permission.

reference_sources.name: Open Prices community observations
reference_sources.reason: A read-only adapter is prepared to retain recent Egypt/EGP community observations separately from retail prices. Do not enable until ODbL compatibility and actual Egypt coverage are confirmed.

reference_sources.name: Information and Decision Support Center — local and global prices
reference_sources.reason: The official IDSC describes daily local prices for 30+ commodities including vegetables, fruit, meat, construction materials and fertilizers, but a public machine-readable API and commercial redistribution terms were not verified. Seek an approved data feed rather than extracting app traffic.

excluded_categories_note: Do not activate sources for medicines or other restricted products through this generic updater. Use official public registration information only; no unverified price claims.
